performance.verdict: $118 spent, 0 leads: campaigns live but attribution stack is broken.

findings.text: Lead drought confirmed: $118.14 spent across 28 days on Meta, 0 leads recorded. CPL is undefined — no conversion event has ever fired.
OVERDUE (July 31): Pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account & CAPI, and landing pages/tracking all missed July 31 deadline — 43 days overdue.
OVERDUE (Aug 31–Sep 1): Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and reactivation nurture sequences all missed Aug 31–Sep 1 deadlines — up to 12 days overdue.
GBP actions fell -37.5% week-over-week and hit 0 for 3 straight days (Sep 9–11), coinciding with Meta spend ramping — organic discovery is declining while paid spend increases.
GA4 sessions averaged 149 over the last 3 days (Sep 9–11) vs 127 prior 3 days (Sep 6–8) — site traffic is stable, meaning the 0-lead problem is conversion tracking, not reach.

suggestions.text: Halt Meta spend immediately until conversion tracking fires at least 1 verified test lead end-to-end.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has spent $118.14 over 28 days with 0 leads recorded and 0 GA4 conversions — no conversion event has ever fired. Pause all active Meta campaigns and run the overdue end-to-end stack test (lead form → GHL/NextGen → reporting) per the July 31 SOW milestone. Success is confirmed when 1 test lead appears in GHL with a source tag and is reflected in the reporting dashboard. Target completion: 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Force SOW gate resolution: CAPI, landing pages, and GHL migration must be verified before any budget is re-enabled.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones across Ops, CRM, Meta, Google, and Web are overdue by 12–43 days as of 2026-09-12. Nacer to lead a same-week sign-off meeting confirming: CAPI live and sending events, landing page tracking pixel firing, Como→GHL migration verified, and LSA verification submitted. Success is a written gate sign-off from Nacer with dated evidence per milestone. Target: 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 3-day zero streak (Sep 9–11) warrants monitoring before attributing to seasonal noise.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for three consecutive days (Sep 9–11) and are down -37.5% week-over-week at 94 total actions over 28 days. No paid Google activity is running to explain a halo effect. Re-check on 2026-09-15 — if the 0-action streak extends to 6+ days, escalate to a GBP triage fix per the overdue July 31 SOW milestone.
